gloss: on the contrary; rather; all the more

definitions.gloss: on the contrary; rather; all the more
definitions.explanation: Used when the result is opposite of what was expected, or when something intensifies rather than lessens.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}したら{却|かえ}って{混乱|こんらん}した。
examples.english: When I explained, it only made things more confusing.

examples.japanese: {休|やす}んだのに{却|かえ}って{疲|つか}れた。
examples.english: Even though I rested, I ended up more tired.

examples.japanese: シンプルな{方|ほう}が{却|かえ}って{良|よ}い。
examples.english: The simpler option is actually better.

notes:
USAGE PATTERN:
{却|かえ}って is used when:
1. An action produces the opposite of its intended effect
2. Something unexpected happens that goes against common sense
3. A simpler or different approach turns out better

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜したら{却|かえ}って〜: when I did ~, it actually ~
- 〜の{方|ほう}が{却|かえ}って〜: actually, ~ is more ~
- {却|かえ}って{悪|わる}くなる: to become worse instead

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- むしろ: rather (neutral comparison)
- {逆|ぎゃく}に: on the contrary
